latest_cos_commentary.headline: Star Micronics is a major global POS hardware vendor (kitchen/receipt printers, labeling, cash management) with over a million devices deployed, integrated across most major restaurant ordering and POS platforms.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes at the hardware/peripheral layer (printers, labeling, cash management) that can be paired with or substituted alongside Genius's own hardware recommendations, rather than competing on core POS software or payments processing.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Actively showcasing kitchen-execution, order-accuracy, and cloud-POS-integrated hardware at major 2026 industry trade shows, indicating continued investment in the restaurant hardware category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not a direct software/payments competitor; relevant mainly in hardware-selection conversations (printers, labeling) that may occur alongside a Genius POS/payments deployment.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No restaurant-specific revenue, named restaurant chain customers, or full leadership roster were found in this pass; broad platform-compatibility claims are vendor-published.
